name: Claude Auto Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened]
    branches: [main]
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened]
    branches: [main]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read
  issues: write

jobs:
  claude-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Claude Auto Review
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          trigger_phrase: "@claude review"
          base_branch: main
          branch_prefix: claude-review
          allowed_bots: claude-code-action
          allowed_non_write_users: true
          include_comments_by_actor: true
          exclude_comments_by_actor: claude-code-action
          prompt: |
            You are an expert documentation reviewer for Reown. Your task is to review the pull request for changes to the documentation. Follow these steps:
            1. Read the changed files and understand the context.
            2. Verify technical accuracy, clarity, and formatting.
            3. Check that the content follows Reown’s tone of voice as described in `reown-tone-of-voice-extract.md
